channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Knight’s appeal to be heard Tuesday morning
item.description: N.C. State Board of Elections will hear Wilson County sheriff candidate Bobby Knight’s appeal of his disqualification in a special virtual meeting Tuesday at 11:30 a.m.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 17-18, 2026
item.description: Weekend area sports schedule for Jan. 17-18, 2026, featuring Barton basketball, track and volleyball, plus MLK Day high school hoops showcases and wrestling at West Carteret.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Chargers rip Hilltop Christian to seize region lead
item.description: Wilson Christian’s defense powers a 51-35 win at Hilltop to take the NCCSA 2-A East lead, the Lady Chargers cruise 41-17, and Beddingfield’s girls fall 45-44 in an EPC nail-biter at Ayden-Grifton.

item.title: CCS girls clip Wayne Prep for 3rd win of week
item.description: Shorthanded CCS girls edge Wayne Prep 43-40 at Peace Church gym, capping a 3-0 week and moving to 10-3 behind Autumn Bradshaw’s 17 points and Anna Pierce’s double-double.

item.title: Cycs demote Generals, 81-75
item.description: Community Christian avenged a loss to top-ranked Wayne Prep, rolling 85-64 behind Pierce Stone’s 23 points as the Cyclones improved to 14-5 in boys basketball at Peace Church.

item.title: CBA wears down Fike girls 44-32
item.description: With senior Kylar Horvath sidelined, bigger C.B. Aycock rode 20 points from Alonna Frederick to a 44-32 Big East win at Fike, dropping the Golden Demons to 1-4 in league play despite freshman Bria Harris' 15 points.

item.title: Demons crunch Falcons to keep pace in Big East
item.description: Freshman Denim Murray scored a career-high 24 points as Fike rolled past C.B. Aycock 67-54 for its sixth straight win, setting up a Big East first-place clash with Hunt.

item.title: Gryphons slug Warriors 56-18
item.description: No. 3-ranked Rocky Mount girls completed a dominant first-half sweep of 5-A Big East foes, routing Hunt 56-18 behind Kira Jones’ 19 points to move to 11-2 overall and 5-0 in league play.

item.title: Hunt hums past Rocky Mount 69-54 for 10th straight win
item.description: No. 5 Hunt defeated Rocky Mount 69-54 for its 10th straight win, staying unbeaten in Big East play behind Amere Hall’s 15 points and 8 assists ahead of a Jan. 20 showdown at Fike.

item.title: Firefighters battle wildfires in 2 counties
item.description: Wind-driven wildfires burned across 50–60 acres along East Langley Road in Wilson and Edgecombe counties Saturday.
